Name: Big Round Birds
Author: Ballshorse
Description:
[center][b][u][size=4][/size][/u][/b][/center][b][u][size=4]Overview[/size][/u][/b]

Adds 13 unique bird plushies into the game!

They measure 4 tiles by 2 tiles, so they would need a lot of room
[b][u]


[/u][/b][b][u][size=4]Mod Requirements[/size][/u][/b]

This mod only requires [b]Content patcher [/b]and [b]SMAPI [/b]to work

Though if you would like to place the birds around town, I would recommend [b]Non-Destructive NPCs[/b], but the mod will run perfectly fine without it.
[left]
[b][u][size=4]

[/size][/u][/b][size=4][b][u]The Birds![/u][/b][/size]

[size=3]So far, there are 13 different birds in the game:
[/size][size=2]

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Java Sparrow[/size]
[*][size=3]Long-Tailed Tit[/size]
[*][size=3]Sparrow[/size]
[*][size=3]Swallow[/size]
[*][size=3]Zebra Finch[/size]
[*][size=3]White Dove[/size]
[*][size=3]Pigeon[/size]
[*][size=3]Barn Owl[/size]
[*][size=3]Warbler[/size]
[*][size=3]Kingfisher[/size]
[*][size=3]And three special birdies![/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][b][u][size=4]

Obtaining The Birds[/size][/u][/b]

[size=3]To get the first 10 birds listed:
They are purchasable from the Casino for 10,000 coins each

To get the special birds:
The Casino bird is available from the Casino for 50,000 coins and the Qi bird(s?) can be obtained from the Qi Gem shop for 30 and 20 gems!﻿[/size][/left][left][size=3]


[b][u]More Birds

[/u][/b]I will hopefully update with more round birds in the future and will list them here. I'm happy to have suggestions from the comments of what birds you would like to see :)
